target: docs/41-试点课堂Start持久迁移内核SDD.md §108
review_type: read-only design disposition and source review
summary: The revised §108 closes the prior crash-after-quarantine-write-failure ambiguity at the policy level: a durable open/recovery-required catalog entry must precede any sidecar append or DB write, and a durable terminal/recovery disposition is required before a case is considered clean. After a crash before quarantine persists, startup still sees the durable unresolved marker and must deny fresh commands; it cannot infer health from the old sidecar. Current source also conforms to the tool_started pending_unknown rule and rejects reserved result classes on terminal_failed. Implementation remains blocked because no supervisor/catalog path enforces these requirements, and verified-open, creation authorization, Windows DACL, and Windows directory durability remain integration gates.

round2_dispositions.evidence: §108:114 requires a durable open/recovery-required catalog entry before any sidecar append or DB write, requires durable terminal/recovery disposition before clean status, and mandates startup rejection of unresolved entries before DB/sidecar open. Thus a failed later quarantine append followed by crash still has an earlier durable fail-closed marker, assuming the prescribed ordering is implemented.

pilot_start_sidecar.go validatePilotStartEvent rejects terminal_failed with result_class commit_unknown/rollback_proven (lines 340-342), and nextPilotStartPhase disallows terminal_failed in phases 3 and 5 (tool_started without durable tool_result; lines 366-377,392-396). No tests were run.

control_dispositions.durable_open_marker: required before any sidecar append or DB write; resolves the prior missing-quarantine-marker restart ambiguity if enforced
control_dispositions.quarantine_failure_and_restart: startup treats still-open/recovery-required case as unresolved; no fresh command based on old sidecar health
control_dispositions.tool_started_without_result: pending_unknown; terminal_failed transition excluded in source
control_dispositions.reserved_result_classes: commit_unknown and rollback_proven rejected on terminal_failed in source
control_dispositions.catalog_supervisor: not present in reviewed server implementation; remains blocking
control_dispositions.verified_handle_and_new_case_create: not implemented by sidecar helper; supervisor/capability gate remains
control_dispositions.windows_dacl_and_parent_sync: explicitly delegated but not implemented in reviewed helper; remains blocking integration gate

remaining_conditions: Implement supervisor/catalog state transitions and pre-open startup authorization, including durable open/recovery-required and terminal dispositions.
Integrate verified file/directory handles and enforce new-case-only creation; do not use recovery fallback to create.
Implement Windows effective DACL checks and parent-directory durability before Windows security/durability claims.
Add and run coordinator-level restart/quarantine and Playwright pilot harness acceptance before claiming implementation complete.
limitations: No tests or runtime validation were run.
No supervisor, catalog, fault-injection, restart, path-race, ACL, or platform durability behavior was exercised.
This review approves the written disposition only and does not establish implementation correctness or classroom readiness.
